protocol.heldout: All later directions of the same frozen exact592 Schur trajectory.
protocol.factor: Rebuilt from original C for every mask; FP64 accumulation, complete columns stored FP32 or FP64. No replacement of columns from an exact factor.
protocol.epsilon: At initial all32 construction, norm(w-stored_diagonal*stored_column), including diagonal.
protocol.main_score: Sum over4 normalized current t: epsilon_j*norm(z_j*q[j:]+q_j*z[j:]-z_j*q_j*e1)/(4*(m-j)), z=H0t, q=H0(t-Cz).
protocol.signed_oracle: Free dense F=C-LL.T; selecttop8 max(-sum f_j.dot(vector),0)/(4*(m-j)). Rebuild factor. Diagnostic only; reconstruction cost not a native proposal.
protocol.norm_comparison: All per-direction H1/H2 ratios use identical592 core and frozen direction. 600-core exact trajectory and query formula only separate context.
protocol.scope: Offline accuracy/headroom diagnostic only. No native timing or full-memory claim.

reference_precision.caveat: Action errors use finite-precision dense Cholesky references. Ratios near one or near the reference residual floor do not establish a strict accuracy ordering.

core600_context.caveat: Exact trajectory counts only, not mixed/inexact iteration predictions. Formula excludes setup, selection, boundaries, probes and original verification; no native comparison.
